entities.summary: Bishop Fabijan Svalina is a Roman Catholic prelate who is currently serving as a Diocesan Bishop of the Diocese of Srijem since 14 February 2024. Previously he served as a Coadjutor Bishop of the same Diocese since 7 October 2021 until 14 February 2024.
